notes.title: Late Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The barrage of updates that came shortly after the games release fixed the following issues.


Level 6 and 8 crashing the game.
Levels 29-40 not saving/loading properly.
Fixed an issue where falling platforms were the wrong texture.
minor/major bug fixes
